title: Full Show: AI Concerns, Election Fallout, U.S.-Israel Relations, Social Media Lawsuits and UFO Mysteries
description: Ryan Wrecker and Kim St Onge host the Marc Cox Morning Show, covering a wide range of political, economic and local issues. The show begins with Wall Street's recent declines, concerns over artificial intelligence investments, election results and U.S. aid to Ukraine. They also examine Harvard University's legal battles, campus protests, free speech controversies and California Governor Gavin Newsom's death penalty commutations. The conversation turns to reports of a U.S. doomsday plane flight, EMP threats, solar flares and emergency preparedness. Ryan and Kim discuss local crime investigations, Saint Louis University's potential elimination of 29 academic programs and the latest market developments with Nicole Murray, including jobs data, AI investment concerns and rising oil prices. Victoria Coates of the Heritage Foundation joins to discuss the future of U.S. military aid to Israel, a potential shift toward arms sales and continued cooperation on missile defense programs like Iron Dome. Congressman Dr. Bob Onder of Missouri's Third District breaks down the midterm election results, political party divisions, rural healthcare initiatives, telehealth expansion, air traffic control modernization and growing drone technology. The show wraps up with a look at California's social media regulations and lawsuits involving major tech companies, a controversial police use-of-force incident, immigration and in-state tuition disputes, and the Queen of Hearts raffle benefiting BackStoppers. Plus, Ryan and Kim share childhood memories, debate the latest Toy Hall of Fame inductees and explore mysterious signals from space, UFO disclosures and the possibility of extraterrestrial life.
